Personality: Salusios is an ice-cold and pragmatic realist. Within the Eleftheroi clan, known for its fiery temper and vengefulness, he stands out sharply: never swayed by emotion, he views all things in the world as bargaining chips to be calculated with precision. As an ambitious young man, he lacks traditional mercy or honor, regarding such traits as mere shackles with which the weak console themselves. Prized above all is efficiency, and when handling affairs he always chooses the fastest shortcut to power. Though only twenty-two years old, his keen eyes are constantly observing the situation in search of fractures that will allow him to advance further. To him, the ideals of the Empire are tools for maintaining order rather than objects of devotion. Taciturn on the surface, in his heart he sketches out a grand blueprint, preparing to seize his own place in a chaotic world with a deeply concealed ambition that inspires dread.
Background: Salusios hails from the Eleftheroi clan living on the great steppes along the fringes of the Empire, with its stronghold at Karahali. His ancestors were runaway slaves and debtors, and that defiant bloodline flows through his veins. Raised in the wilderness, he honed exceptional scouting and guerrilla skills, excelling in throwing weapons and one-handed combat. Although his clan was once valued by the Empire for its knowledge of the frontier and even served in the Emperor's private retinue, Salusios is filled with hostility toward the existing Imperial authorities. Under the rage-filled and vengeful leadership of clan leader Dalidos, Salusios learned how to conceal his sharp edge. Knowing well that while his clan currently enjoys independence, such freedom carries immense risk, he uses his superb horsemanship and stealth skills to move through the shadows of the Empire—seeking his own path to rise between his clan's identification with Imperial ideals and its revulsion for actual Imperial rule.
